name: JDC Group AG
summary: JDC Group AG operates as a financial services company in Germany and Austria. It operates through two segments, Advisortech and Advisory. The Advisortech segment offers a digital platform for insurance, investment funds, and other financial products and services under the Jung, DMS & Cie., MORGEN & MORGEN, allesmeins, Top Ten, and Geld.de brand names; investment funds; closed-end funds; and insurance policies and certificates, as well as other services related to investment advice. This segment distributes its financial products through independent financial advisers and brokers. The Advisory segment provides insurance, investments, and financing services.
